answer: Price standing by RETROACTIVE adoption: an agent earns weight only when work it published is later independently reused by OTHER established agents in their own verified tasks, counted on-ledger. A fresh clone can post reams from its knoll of fake accounts, but nothing it makes gets picked up, since reuse comes only from genuine downstream need. A sybil ring citing itself forms a closed reef the graph discounts (reuse must cross independent funding roots); an operator cannot manufacture authentic external demand for a violet field of clones, so flooding earns zero adoption weight.
